scope: One exact learned77 policy on all eight mandatory development conditions at83301, plus the previously failing strong-tailwind route84001. Two new mild PID flights complete the declared controls. Not reserved final confirmation.
intended_policy_family: Learned W8/Path77 CONTROL selected by root after completed v8/v9 integrity and native-quality audits. Root chose matched-budget v8 FULLCONTROL FINAL before any learned77 Gazebo data; the unused earlier v9 binding is superseded without a flight. No effective K40 corner reward. Exact NPZ/evidence remains a separate root binding.
new_methods: One joint77 flight for each9 profile; add native frozen PID only for both mild83301 profiles, on the same lane as their joint flight.
schedule: Build9 joint profiles and2 mild PID jobs, shuffle once with Python random.Random(83301), then preserve each native lane queue. Four batches up to3 concurrent lanes; each batch ends and all poses flush before all-three-port/process preflight for the next. Global order defines queues, not exact simultaneous wall-clock starts.
quality_rule: All unchanged operational gates are conjunctions. Report the mandatory8-condition gate, additional84001 tailwind gate and original six-wind-cell15% macro separately. Native hard-guard failure keeps a root-authorized diagnostic candidate diagnostic even if a measured Gazebo subset passes.
original_macro: 83301 only:1 - mean(penalized_goal_RMSE_joint across mild/strong/gust x hover/route) / mean(the corresponding six paired PID values). Equal weight per cell; nominal, tail84001 and old wind retention are excluded. This is a ratio of two six-cell means, not a mean of six relative ratios.
coverage_rule: Shared PID/reference flights are controls only. No W8/Gamma74 or smoke flight fills an unmeasured learned77 cell. All11 new cases run once; retain every valid failure and all20 total observations. No final seed93001/93002/93003.
error_rule: Valid controller FAIL retained and fixed matrix continues. Infrastructure/observer/audit ERROR stops unstarted batches; preserve all raw attempts and exact reason. No automatic retry/resume/replacement, no seed or policy change inside matrix.
limitations: One learned actor, one viewed primary environment83301 and one declared stress direction84001. Historical competent PID controls are shared once. Missing independent training/environment replication remains. Absolute-time force phases may differ across route controllers. Force is inN, not wind speed. Mild enables development macro evaluation but does not imply numeric success. No new training/server/GUI/video by this runner.

position_goal_rmse.reward: Inherited trained CONTROL goal error/speed reward; no reward changes or training in this matrix.
position_goal_rmse.checkpoint: Root binds exact independently audited selected policy; do not reselect using these Gazebo results.
position_goal_rmse.evaluation: Independent full30s/40s goal-distance RMSE and4m-tail penalized RMSE. Every route<=1.05 pairedPID penalized value.
position_goal_rmse.known_gap: Goal distance is not cross-track; route terminal hover remains in this original thesis metric only.

height_max_down.reward: Inherited vertical tracking term; no direct new max reward.
height_max_down.checkpoint: Report all selected-policy errors, no posthoc checkpoint switch.
height_max_down.evaluation: Independent maximum downward error versus active goal plus pre-force auxiliary when available.
height_max_down.known_gap: Commanded route height steps are not an uncommanded physical drop. No invented numeric acceptance threshold.

recovery_time.reward: Inherited hover tracking under wind; no explicit new recovery timer.
recovery_time.checkpoint: Original fixed hover retention constraints; root frozen policy.
recovery_time.evaluation: Hover only after independently verified actual final forceOFF;0.25m band continuously1s, censoring retained.
recovery_time.known_gap: Already inside at OFF is not millisecond adaptation. Route recovery not substituted for hover.

stability_full_flight.reward: Inherited safety termination; no new reward.
stability_full_flight.checkpoint: Native all-flight hard guards must pass for acceptance-candidate status; failed native model is diagnostic.
stability_full_flight.evaluation: Every9 joint flight survived, full horizon and valid status. Valid failures remain in denominators; paired PID validity also checked.
stability_full_flight.known_gap: No new fault/noise/delay coverage; SITL survival does not establish real hardware safety.

route_completion_time.reward: Inherited arrival10/completion20 and W8; continued learning evidence belongs to training receipts.
route_completion_time.checkpoint: Native fixed route time/complete guards; no Gazebo checkpoint reselection.
route_completion_time.evaluation: All5 joint routes confirm5 ordered0.5s dwells; restricted time40s when incomplete, otherwise actualtime<=1.05 matchedPID.
route_completion_time.known_gap: Force clock is absolute; a faster route sees different corner exposure.

heading.reward: Inherited yaw tracking; commanded yaw remains common initial reference.
heading.evaluation: Every valid full flight RMS<=5deg and absolutepeak<=15deg including PIDreference validity.
heading.known_gap: Waypoint90deg turns are not90deg commanded yaw steps.

nominal_hover_accuracy.reward: Inherited hover tracking, no new reward.
nominal_hover_accuracy.checkpoint: Original Gamma native retention anchor remains separate from new Gazebo PID gate.
nominal_hover_accuracy.known_gap: One viewed development environment, not reserved confirmation.

wind_hover_gain.reward: Inherited wind distribution and tracking; actual training evidence hash-bound.
wind_hover_gain.checkpoint: Native hover guards and root choice bound before matrix.
wind_hover_gain.evaluation: Strong/gust83301 penalized hoverRMSE<=.85 correspondingPID; mild belongs to six-cell macro without added per-cell15%requirement.
wind_hover_gain.known_gap: Three force profiles do not mean all wind directions/speeds. Newton proxies are notm/s.

wind_specialist_retention.reward: Inherited original hover task; no fresh reward adjustment.
wind_specialist_retention.checkpoint: Original Gamma native anchor not loosened; actualold specialist paired onlystrong/gusthover83301.
wind_specialist_retention.evaluation: Joint strong/gusthoverRMSE<=1.10 matched oldwind111specialist; exact policyddd0... and2sharedflights verified.
wind_specialist_retention.known_gap: Legacy specialist has older throttle semantics; this is retained integrated-system reference, not new matched causal PPO ablation.

route_finite_segment_rmse.reward: InheritedW8=-dt*8*finite active3D segment error squared on pre-update goals1..4.
route_finite_segment_rmse.checkpoint: Native finite targets unchanged; root policy chosen before Gazebo.
route_finite_segment_rmse.evaluation: Independent pre-transition active finite3D transit RMSE excluding final hover <=max(1.10*pairedPID,pairedPID+.01). All5joint routes, each geometry complete.
route_finite_segment_rmse.known_gap: Nominal finite target is still required even if native/Gazebo return improves. No criterion relaxation.

route_corner_peak.reward: CONTROL has no effective K40 corner reward; that branch was rejected. Inherited tracking/W8 can only influence corners indirectly.
route_corner_peak.checkpoint: Native corner hard constraints and fixed policy binding.
route_corner_peak.evaluation: All3 interior outgoing finite3D peaks in closed1s windows; mean<=max(1.10*pairedPID,pairedPID+.02), gap<=.060001 and complete coverage.
route_corner_peak.known_gap: No direct corner reward in intended controller; this explicit residual mismatch cannot be hidden by overall return or mean finite error.

route_absolute_peak.reward: Inherited path/safety penalties, no added max clipping or new reward.
route_absolute_peak.checkpoint: Every native route peak<=.50 for acceptance-candidate status.
route_absolute_peak.evaluation: Every joint active-segment peak<=.50m including tail84001. Never average away one failed seed or corner.
route_absolute_peak.known_gap: A pass in these5 development routes does not prove all force timing/directions.

thesis_six_cell_macro.reward: Inherited training objective is not exactly the six-cell macro; no macro reward change in this matrix.
thesis_six_cell_macro.checkpoint: Freeze chosen actor before all new flights; no selection on resulting macro.
thesis_six_cell_macro.evaluation: 1 - mean6joint penalized goalRMSE/mean6pairedPID >=.15, mild/strong/gust x hover/route83301, equal cell weights. New mild2PID+2joint finally cover missingcells.
thesis_six_cell_macro.known_gap: Ratio of means, not mean of ratios. Nominal/tail/legacy references excluded. This remains development-only, one actor/environment; final114flight matrix still required.
